label: Bible Study
prompt: For from the _____ of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: From sunrise to sunset — God's name great among the nations, in the last book of the Old Testament.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou shalt also be a _____ of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verse: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
note: God's people as a crown of glory held in His hand — treasured, not just tolerated.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a _____, and lighting upon him:
verse: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
note: At Jesus' baptism the heavens opened and the Spirit descended like a dove — Father, Son, and Spirit all in one scene.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the _____ of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
verse: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
note: Daniel's throne-room vision: the Ancient of days in white, his throne blazing like fire.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set _____ against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
verse: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
note: Jehoshaphat sent singers ahead of the army; 'when they began to sing,' the LORD set 'ambushments.' Worship as battle plan.
